name: Timeline
description: A ferry operator's alerts, deploys, chat, support tickets and automated agents' actions on one time axis: a lane per source under the time range's viewfinder, narrowed to an incident or a search and colored by any field or label, and the events in the range in a list where each opens in place with the event it answers and those that answer it.

records.name: event
records.one: one alert, deploy step, chat message, ticket message or agent action

fields.name: time
fields.how: read in UTC, a deploys.csv time without an offset as UTC+1

fields.name: kind
fields.how: firing read as fired, a ticket's first message as opened

fields.name: actor
fields.from: by, user, From or the agent
fields.how: a login or chat id as chat/users.json names it

fields.name: service
fields.from: svc or service, the summary, tickets/index.csv
fields.how: a missing service from the summary's first word

fields.name: severity
fields.from: severity, or a ticket's priority in tickets/index.csv
fields.how: the priority word in free text

fields.name: outcome
fields.how: ok, failed or held, other words dropped

fields.name: incident
fields.from: incident, an inc- channel or an INC number in the text
fields.how: a deploy's later steps take its incident

fields.name: answers
fields.from: resolves, deploy, thread_ts, ticket order, alert, ticket or via
fields.how: the id of the event this one answers

fields.name: took
fields.how: seconds since the event it answers

accepts.means: the event on line <n>, or the nearest event when the line holds none, opened in place in the list

units.means: one incident's events, such as INC-312, narrowed to it with the viewfinder on its span
one day's events in UTC, the viewfinder on that day
the events between two UTC times written YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, the viewfinder on that window
